text.en: Dog owners are consistently delighted with the quality of styling and coat maintenance provided at the parlour. Reviewers remark that their pets leave looking immaculate, smelling fresh, and sporting natural trims that surpass results experienced at larger commercial salon chains.

title.en: Comfort and play for visiting dogs

text.en: Clients note that even restless or nervous dogs settle in quickly and actually come to love their grooming sessions. Pet parents appreciate that dogs have room to play freely and explore the secure outdoor garden, creating a relaxed, homely environment where pets never want to leave.

Proprietor Mohammed and his styling team receive glowing recommendations for their polite, patient, and courteous service. Reviewers highlight their reliable punctuality regarding collection times, clear communication, and gentle dedication to the wellbeing of every client's dog.

a.en: The parlour is located on St Mary's Road in Brent, operating from a private premises with dedicated play areas and garden access.

q.en: Does the salon groom puppies and restless dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that puppies and restless pets quickly feel at home thanks to the patient, unhurried care of the team.
Yes, the parlour offers ultrasonic dental cleaning alongside coat styling, bath packages, and nail trimming.
